channel.title: Portputer Updates
channel.description: Updates for Portputer on the Mac.

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
• Typing at the Mac lock screen works. Keys reach the password field.
  • Windows: Control-Windows-Escape returns the keyboard to Windows. Before, it had no effect while Send keyboard to computer was on.
  • Android: fixed a crash after the computer closed the connection, when the clipboard changed with Share Clipboard on.

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description:
• Typing at the Mac login window works, VoiceOver keys included.
  • Computer Audio at the Mac login window, with the Portputer Microphone driver installed (Settings, Microphone).
  • After the login window, the Mac's audio outputs are put back as they were.
  • After a restart, the Mac's login window server reconnects to the internet relay sooner, and devices find it on more of its addresses.
  • After updating Portputer on the Mac, Settings shows Update beside login window support and the microphone driver when they're from the older version. Updating them needs an administrator's password.

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
• The first release of Portputer: control a Mac or Windows computer from an Android phone or another computer, with a screen reader.
  • Every key of an external keyboard, system shortcuts included, the computer's audio, the phone's microphone as an input on the Mac, clipboard and file transfer, and power control.
  • Typing at the Mac login window after a restart, and Restart Without FileVault Unlock.
  • Reaches paired computers on the same network, over Tailscale or another VPN, or through the internet relay, with nothing to set up.
